message: Operator clarification, now recorded in canonical task version 4 (spec v3): In fresh Jarvis-created ChatGPT home tabs, RESTORED composer drafts are disposable. Replace whatever composer text is there through ordinary UI editing, verify exact intended bootstrap prompt, then click Send once. No stale-draft matching, prompt-history persistence, or provenance gate is needed for that newly-created owned tab. Do not touch unrelated preexisting user tabs or existing conversations, and never replay when a Send may already have occurred. The browser multi-connection ownership/routing fix remains unchanged. Read the revised canonical task spec and explicitly align the implementation/review with it; no separate approval needed for this operator-authorized simplification.
